title: Village Pond Cleanliness Awareness Cards
problem: People wash clothes with harsh chemical detergents near our village lake. The water becomes harmful for cattle that drink from the same pond.
idea: Polite awareness cards to put near the washing steps, plus a quiz so everyone learns why the pond needs care.

items.title: Cattle drink here
items.text: Please wash clothes away from the pond. Our cows and buffaloes drink this water.
items.te: దయచేసి చెరువు దూరంలో బట్టలు ఉతకండి. మన పశువులు ఈ నీరు తాగుతాయి.

items.title: Use a bucket
items.text: Take water in a bucket and wash on the land. Let soapy water soak into the soil.
items.te: బకెట్‌లో నీరు తీసుకుని ఒడ్డుకు దూరంగా ఉతకండి.

items.title: Less soap
items.text: A little detergent is enough. Too much foam kills fish and frogs.
items.te: కొంచెం సబ్బు చాలు. ఎక్కువ నురుగు చేపలకు హానికరం.

items.title: No waste
items.text: Do not throw plastic or puja waste into the pond.

items.title: Thank you
items.text: A clean pond means healthy cattle and a healthy village.

questions.q: Where is the best place to wash clothes?
options: On land, away from the pond
questions.why: Soapy water soaks into soil instead of polluting the pond.

questions.q: What happens when too much detergent goes into a pond?
questions.why: Detergents add chemicals that harm fish, plants and animals.

questions.q: How should we tell people about this?
options: Use polite cards and talk kindly
questions.why: Kind words work better than anger.

how: Ask Gemini to write 5 short, polite messages about keeping the pond clean.
Check the Telugu translation with your teacher.
Open Canva, choose a card or poster template and add one message on each card.
Add pictures of cattle, fish and a clean pond.
Print the cards, laminate or cover them with plastic sheet, and ask the Sarpanch for permission.
Put the cards near the washing steps and talk kindly with the women and men who wash there.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write 5 short, polite awareness messages in simple Telugu and English asking villagers to wash clothes away from the pond because cattle drink that water. Do not sound angry.
